task: Recover transient Bol reads and make the paused scanner state truthful

producers.source_condition: The complete multi-source snapshot is loading, ready, refreshing, fresh-with-warning, stale, or unavailable.
producers.user_impact: The operator can or cannot safely scan packages.
producers.recovery: Wait for completion, continue on the last complete fresh snapshot, or use Retry when scanning is paused.
producers.copy_purpose: Communicate snapshot readiness and the safe recovery action.
producers.final_copy: Data complete / Scanning paused — shipment data is incomplete. Retry before scanning.
producers.external_proof: Data-health browser assertions and current desktop/mobile state inspection

producers.source_condition: canScan changes between false for unhealthy data and true after a complete healthy snapshot commits.
producers.user_impact: The operator must know whether the scanner input is safe to use.
producers.recovery: Use Retry while paused; resume scanning only after READY returns.
producers.copy_purpose: Keep heading, hint, WAIT/READY flag, current status, and input enablement consistent.
producers.external_proof: Browser copy, disabled/enabled input, focus, and recovery assertions

producers.source_condition: No real package decision exists and the scanner is either ready-idle or paused for unhealthy data.
producers.user_impact: The operator needs a truthful first decision-zone message instead of a contradictory idle claim.
producers.recovery: Retry when paused; scan the first package when ready.
producers.copy_purpose: Use the decision zone to reinforce the current safe action without replacing a real prior decision.
producers.final_copy: No parcel scanned yet / Shipment data is incomplete — retry before scanning.
producers.external_proof: Data-health state assertions and screenshot inspection

producers.source_condition: A package scan resolves as GO, duplicate, cancelled, unknown, or unverified.
producers.user_impact: The operator needs the dispatch or pull-aside decision to remain visible.
producers.recovery: Continue with GO/duplicate or remove/review STOP packages; retry data separately if the station later pauses.
producers.copy_purpose: Preserve the authoritative package decision through later snapshot state changes.
producers.final_copy: Existing GO, duplicate, and STOP decision copy.
producers.external_proof: Existing scan-flow and new paused-after-decision browser assertions

producers.source_condition: A server-only Bol request retries a transport or retryable status failure within its bounded attempt budget.
producers.user_impact: No visible impact when recovery succeeds; exhausted recovery is mapped by snapshot_health.
producers.copy_purpose: Keep attempt counts, statuses, delays, and raw upstream detail outside visible and assistive output.
producers.external_proof: Focused Bol client unit tests and sanitized Vercel request-status logs

producers.source_condition: Health or decision status changes after data load or retry.
producers.user_impact: Assistive-technology users receive the same actionable ready/paused result.
producers.recovery: Use the labeled Retry control when paused.
producers.copy_purpose: Expose the product-owned health and decision state through existing live regions.
producers.final_copy: Same localized health, readiness, and decision copy as the visible channel.
producers.external_proof: Role, aria-live, disabled-state, and accessible-name browser assertions

what_must_not_appear: HTTP status codes, retry attempt counts, retry delays, stack traces, raw API errors, or implementation narration
Bol client credentials, OAuth tokens, account identifiers, or raw upstream payloads
A ready heading or idle-ready decision while unhealthy data disables the scanner
A paused empty-state replacement that erases a real prior package decision
Vercel, Turso, test, receipt, or verification proof chrome
